_note: The person's own patches in their LoopWorkspace patches/ folder, by file name without its number ("08-meal-patterns-and-tools.patch" is meal-patterns-and-tools). Read from Rdeboer180/LoopWorkspace @ Rdeboer180-patch-AT on 2026-11-14. rank orders the cards (lowest first); the build still applies files in file-name order. dosing: LoopStack's reading of whether it changes what Loop doses or is told (PRODUCT.md SAFE-3). canTurnOn:false is never turned on by LoopStack (SAFE-6: it removes a safety check). A file not listed here is named from its file name and treated as dosing. Shared by the main process (personal.cjs) and the page (loopCustomizations.ts).

items.name: Delayed metabolic response
items.what: The 🥜 absorption pattern picker for meals that land late: high fat, protein or fibre. Each carb entry and favorite can carry the pattern, and Loop models that entry on the delayed curve.
bundle: 350 g carb entries (warning above 200 g unchanged)
Favorites export and import as CSV
48 hours of retained insulin counteraction effects
items.note: The delayed curve itself is in your LoopKit fork (Rdeboer180/LoopKit_absorption), which your build uses as its LoopKit. Turning this off removes the picker and the tools below; LoopStack doesn’t change the fork.

items.name: Absorption pattern in Nightscout
items.what: Writes each entry's absorption pattern into the Nightscout note, so LoopStack can tell which meals used the delayed curve.

items.name: Past meals to favorites
items.what: Save a meal you already ate as a favorite, optionally with the carbs Loop observed absorbing.

items.name: 24-hour carb history
items.what: A rolling 24 hours of carb entries below the active ones, including meals that have fully absorbed.

items.name: Carb entry order
items.what: The carb entry screen in the order you use it: favorite, food type, pattern, then time.

items.name: Pre-meal in blue, replace favorites
items.what: The pre-meal button uses the workout blue so it doesn’t read as a second carb button, and favorites import can replace the whole list.

items.name: Absorption times up to 12 hours
items.what: The longest absorption time goes from 8 to 12 hours, and carbs can be dated up to 4 hours ahead.
items.source: Yours, with Loop and Learn’s future_carbs_4h folded in

items.name: Absorption quick picks 2.5, 4 and 6 hours
items.what: The fast quick pick goes from 1.5 to 2.5 hours; medium and slow are 4 and 6 hours.
items.source: Yours, with the community absorption-times change folded in

items.name: Carb warning at 200 g
items.what: Loop warns above 200 g in one entry instead of 99 g.

items.name: Therapy profiles
items.what: Save and load sets of therapy settings, pinned to the version that fits your Loop.
items.source: Loop and Learn’s profiles, pinned in your patches

items.name: No Face ID for bolus
items.what: Removes the Face ID or passcode check before a bolus. LoopStack can turn it off, which brings the check back, but never turns it on.
items.source: Loop and Learn’s no_auth, in your patches
